usedFor: Groove holds support tickets, and Slack gets the update in a channel through “Send Message” when a ticket starts.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Assigned” in Groove, then “Create Private Channel” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Assigning a ticket opens a private channel, so the owner and helpers work the case in one place.

watchOut: A post to a Slack channel waits for approval, so “Send Message” does not appear until you approve it.
